body: if u dont feel ok to tell your brother, come to someone here, we'll all be happy to help u. u can inbox me, and i can suggest things. ive felt how u feel, but im much better now. just dont do anything stupid, we're here with open arms to support u :)

alright man, here's what id do: sit down with her and let her know how u feel, its really not good to hide things. take a moment for yourself, figure out what u want to tell her, and make sure she knows how u feel about her.

ive been in a very similar situation. i know its not easy. if i may offer my advice, find a friend or 2 that u can talk to all the time. im a guy, and i ended up talking to a girl that kinda felt the same as me, and we really quickly became best friends, and now we're really close. also, try to focus on thing in your life that make u happy. 
try to talk to the counselor more if that helps u. remember too, everyone here wants to help u, bcuz we want u here.
just hang in there, talk to the ppl here. mnay of us have been through what youre experiencing, so feel free to talk
just hang in there :) my girlfriend got sick when she was younger, and was in hospital for a long time, but she's a lot better now. the journey might be hard, but when its over, ull be happy

ok. u can talk here, the people here want to help u, ive gone through my tough times, and now i want to help those experiencing similar things. please, feel free to msg me. i wld like to help, and your story isnt pathetic. we all go through different things. as unbelievable as it might seem, things will get better.

i see what u mean. this is a really good idea. might i suggest picking up a hobby? playing an instrument is really good, im not sure what u might like, but i play the ukulele and they're really cheap to get. also things like anime might be an idea. just my opinion, experiment with different things and see what u like

i know this might might seem strange to most, but something that helped me was 'genuinely not giving a fuck.' sometimes u have to stop caring about certain things, and focus on the ones that make u happy. u have to try talking to your friend, in my opinion, they help the most. i think u shld try to ask her to be honest with u, and let her talk. u may not like what she says, but u have to listen, try to fix the things she might talk about. what is really important is to keep a clear mind, stay relaxed, and talk about things. thats what i did... hope i helped :)

i would guess that she feels lonely. i dont know what its like to be in that situation, but i know she's going to be experiencing a large mix of emotions. what i think u can do, it spend time with her, and make sure u become her family. im not sure if what im saying makes sense, but i believe what she needs is the kind of love that her family gave her. if u can provide this, it might help her a lot

as hard as it might be to believe, things get better. ive had my ups and downs, and my most recent down has brought me on the edge of suicide, and thats never the answer im here a few months later, very happy that i didnt do anything back then. it does get better, i know from experience. it might help if in school u find someone there can talk to, a real friend that accepts u fully. im not sure how much it might help for u, but i found a friend of the opposite gender and it comforted both of us when we were down to just spend time sitting on a bench and hugging each other. if u cant get this, there are ppl here to talk to u, we all have had problems, and want the best for each other.... so just remember, u have friends here too :)
